notes:
Test build for field testing. If you're not testing, you don't need this — the live build stays as it is.

- Drone cards with several dates go straight through, and drones are no longer filed as tripods
- A card waiting on another card's backup check now verifies after that card finishes, instead of failing with "needs dest-hash"
- RODEs held by another transfer show as "in use by …" instead of disappearing
- Footage already backed up for another wedding is judged by what was actually copied, so a shared RODE or drone doesn't block today's wedding
- New: a "Test build" badge, and Return to stable in Settings → Unlock codes to go back to the live build any time
